svg.title: Keyline data flow
svg.desc: Tools and panels call OperationManager, which validates through the constraint solver and commits to the typed VectorDocument. Renderers, persistence, collaboration and export all read the committed document.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keyline · one mutation path, many consumers

text.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every edit goes through OperationManager. Nothing renders, saves, syncs or exports an uncommitted graph.
